steps.en: After submitting, an acknowledgement page appears
The page confirms URA received it, with a reference number
steps.id: Halaman menyatakan URA menerima, lengkap dengan nomor referensi

steps.en: A table lists the notices that were furnished
The page also shows the hirer or driver details that were furnished
steps.id: Halaman juga menampilkan detail hirer/driver yang di-furnish

steps.en: A Print button lets the user print the page
steps.id: Tombol Print memungkinkan user mencetak halaman

steps.en: The user can save a PDF copy
steps.id: User bisa menyimpan salinan dalam PDF
steps.why_en: No download button; a PDF copy is only possible through the browser print dialog.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tombol unduh; PDF hanya lewat dialog print browser.
